findings.evidence: CALL FUNCTION 'POPUP_TO_CONFIRM' EXPORTING text_question = 'Really update all prices?' IMPORTING answer = lv_answer.
findings.reason: POPUP_TO_CONFIRM is a non-released function module that relies on SAP GUI dynpro processing. It is not available in ABAP Cloud (no released API contract).
findings.suggested_action: Replace the user-confirmation pattern with a Fiori elements confirmation action (RAP action with confirmation step) or, for background use, remove the interactive guard entirely and enforce the check via authorisation or application job parameters.
unknowns: Whether a released successor function module or class for modal confirmation dialogs exists on the specific target release
Whether the program is intended to run interactively (Fiori) or as a background job — the replacement strategy differs

findings.evidence: SELECT * FROM mbew INTO TABLE lt_mbew WHERE bwkey = p_werks.
findings.reason: MBEW is an SAP-delivered material valuation table. Direct SELECT on SAP tables bypasses the released API layer; the release status of MBEW for ABAP Cloud on the target system must be verified separately.
findings.suggested_action: Read material valuation data through a released CDS view (candidate: I_MaterialStock or a valuation-specific released view — verify exact name and availability on target release).
unknowns: Exact released CDS view name covering MBEW fields STPRS, MATNR, BWKEY on the target release
Whether MBEW has a compatibility view released for ABAP Cloud on this target

findings.reason: Direct UPDATE on SAP table MBEW bypasses all business logic, locking, change documents, and price-change history that standard posting processes maintain. This is a Level-D pattern (not recommended / blocked in ABAP Cloud).
findings.suggested_action: Replace with a released RAP Business Object or BAPI for standard-price update (e.g. BAPI_MATERIAL_SAVEDATA with costing data, or an EML MODIFY call against a released RAP BO — verify exact API on target). COMMIT WORK at line 37 must also move to the released API commit mechanism.
unknowns: Which released API (BAPI or RAP BO) covers standard-price update for material valuation on the target release
Whether the price-change requires a CO/Costing document (MR21 equivalent) that only the standard API creates

findings.evidence: CALL TRANSACTION 'MM02' USING lt_bdc MODE 'N' UPDATE 'S'.
findings.reason: CALL TRANSACTION with BDC replay of MM02 requires SAP GUI screen processing which does not exist in ABAP Cloud. This is a Level-D pattern.
findings.suggested_action: Replace the BDC path with the same released RAP BO / BAPI used for F-03. The entire BDCDATA infrastructure (lines 12–14, 51–64) becomes redundant once the direct API path is used.
unknowns: Which released API replaces the MM02 BDC path for material master costing data update on the target release

findings.reason: Classic list output via WRITE is not supported in ABAP Cloud (no SAP GUI list processing).
findings.suggested_action: Surface results through a Fiori elements List Report or return a structured result from an Application Log / Application Jobs callback; for a batch scenario, write to the application job log (CL_APJ_RT_API).
unknowns: Whether the program is intended to run interactively (Fiori action) or as a scheduled background job — the output mechanism differs

findings.evidence:
FORM bdc_dynpro USING program dynpro. ... ENDFORM.
FORM bdc_field USING fnam fval. ... ENDFORM.
findings.reason: FORM/PERFORM subroutines are obsolete in ABAP for Cloud Development language version and not allowed.
findings.suggested_action: Inline the BDCDATA population logic into private methods of a class, or — preferably — remove it entirely once the BDC path (F-04) is replaced by a released API.

findings.evidence: DATA: lt_mbew TYPE TABLE OF mbew, ls_mbew TYPE mbew, lt_bdc TYPE TABLE OF bdcdata, ls_bdc TYPE bdcdata, lv_answer TYPE c.
findings.reason: Chained DATA: declarations are not forbidden by CC-10 per se, but the use of untyped TYPE c (length 1, no length specified explicitly) and ABAP-typed structure declarations tied to physical SAP tables are migration-time code quality issues. The main concern is the TABLE OF mbew / TYPE mbew pattern which directly references an SAP database table as a type — this is coupled to the direct-table-access findings above.
findings.suggested_action: Redeclare all data objects against released CDS view-based types or locally defined structures. Use inline DATA( ) where possible.
unknowns: Whether TYPE TABLE OF mbew is explicitly blocked by the ATC Cloud check on the target release (table-type declarations against unreleased tables may trigger a separate ATC check)

findings.evidence:
LOOP AT lt_mbew INTO ls_mbew.
  ls_mbew-stprs = ls_mbew-stprs * ( 1 + p_pct / 100 ).
  UPDATE mbew FROM ls_mbew.
ENDLOOP.
findings.reason: Business logic concern: the program updates STPRS (standard price) without checking the price control indicator (VPRSV). Materials with price control 'V' (moving average) should not have STPRS updated directly. Updating STPRS for a 'V'-controlled material without a proper posting creates inconsistency between the price and the stock value. No CC rule covers this logic error, but verification-rules.md requires flagging wrong-looking logic.
findings.suggested_action: Before any price update, filter or branch on VPRSV = 'S' (standard price control). For 'V' materials, either skip or raise a dedicated error. Verify the exact field and value with the target costing configuration.
unknowns: Whether all materials in the plant are guaranteed to carry price control S — if so the risk is mitigated but the guard should still be explicit
Whether the released API used as replacement enforces this check itself

Exact released CDS view that exposes MBEW fields (STPRS, BWKEY, MATNR, VPRSV) in ABAP Cloud
Exact released API (RAP BO or BAPI) for standard-price update of material valuation — BAPI_MATERIAL_SAVEDATA is a candidate but its release status for ABAP Cloud must be checked
Whether the interactive confirmation popup (POPUP_TO_CONFIRM) must be replaced by a Fiori confirmation action or simply removed for a background-only redesign
Whether the p_bdc BDC path needs to be preserved at all, or can be dropped in favour of a single released-API path
Price-control-indicator guard (VPRSV): confirm all in-scope materials are price-control S, or mandate the API enforces this
Authorization concept: the current program has no explicit authority-check; the replacement must clarify which authorization objects govern mass price changes
